body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> VUTEC presented a series of its ‘art screen’ during CES 2007. You can choose a certain work and frame and display them at ordinary times; but, you can also use it as a screen when necessary by lifting it up by pressing a button.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
